BackstoryDef.title: tower-born
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born in a border watchtower and raised on its stairs. [PAWN_pronoun] learned stonework from patching walls and swordwork from watching the watch.

BackstoryDef.title: border watchman
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] held a dead kingdom's border tower long after the pay stopped coming, because forty years of family had held it before [PAWN_objective]. The watch ended; the standing did not.

BackstoryDef.title: hunter's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the high passes, reading wind and track before letters. The first bow was too big; the second fit.

BackstoryDef.title: company captain
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] led a guild company through passes that ate lesser expeditions: rationing words like arrows, and losing fewer of either than anyone else in the trade.

BackstoryDef.title: copyist's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised in a copying-house among the last books of the old kingdom, and learned early that margins are where the truth hides.

BackstoryDef.title: itinerant scholar
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] carried a reference library across half the rim on one mule and an opinion. Evidence is a full sentence; everything else is marginalia.

BackstoryDef.title: hollow-born
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born in a green hollow the maps forgot, and was raised as much by the hills as by anyone with a name.

BackstoryDef.title: hedge druid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] kept a grove for thirty years: bees, ravens, beds, and the long patience of green things. The hills talk to [PAWN_objective]. They rarely bother with anyone else.
